params.name: q
params.description:
Returns the images for the search term (q).

Example: q=bern

params.name: lat
params.description:
Returns images (provenances) for a point from the E-Pics catalog “Ex meis libris”. The point is defined by lat (latitude) and long (longitude) and optionally dist (radius) in meters (default: 1000).

Example: lat=47.349952

params.name: lon
params.description: Returns images (provenances) for a point from the E-Pics catalog “Ex meis libris”. The point is defined by lat (latitude) and long (longitude) and optionally dist (radius) in meters (default: 1000).

params.name: dist
params.description:
Returns images (provenances) for a point from the E-Pics catalog “Ex meis libris”. The point is defined by lat (latitude) and long (longitude) and optionally dist (radius) in meters (default: 1000).

Example: dist=1000

params.name: edges
params.description:
Should the edges/relations to e-rara also be returned (default: true)?

Example: edges=false

items.docs: Returns images (provenances) from E-Pics catalogue "Ex meis libris".
